Vero Vendetta · GTA cel lookGREEN NIGHT

One wet night in the city: she gets ready under green fluorescent light, wakes the Rocket Bunny Silvia in the car park, drifts the rain-soaked streets and the overpass loop, grabs noodles and eats them on the bonnet above the skyline.

fluorescent lime #7cff4ftoxic green #1fae5bdeep violet #5b2a86lilac #b79cffnear-black #0b0f0dsodium amber #ffb347

Night world. Fluorescent lime green and toxic green are the light, deep violet is the dark, near-black shadows. Lilac only on her tee and the sky glow. Amber sodium light used sparingly, one per location.

Run order

  2. Each card says exactly what goes in the Style slot and the Image slot. EMPTY means leave that slot empty. Drag the pictured refs straight into MJ's Image slot.
  3. S01 runs first. Once it has a winner, that winner goes wherever a card says "S01 winner".
  4. Save each winner as mj/S01.png, mj/S02.png … in the reel folder, or drop them in chat.
